probe: per-layer cosine-NN on 256-dim router logits -> predict next-token top-2 experts

cross_host_office_to_l4.train: office traces only (330 pairs/layer, 3 sampled streams)
cross_host_office_to_l4.note: different token streams (office sampled at temp 0.8, L4 greedy at temp 0) — not memorization; same model + same prompt distribution

interpretation.claim: next-token expert selection is highly predictable from current router logits alone via logit-space similarity; a learned observer beats the identity heuristic by ~4x Jaccard and transfers across hosts
interpretation.prefetch_value: hitting even one of two next experts (Jaccard 87% means at least one hit in nearly all tokens) hides half the expert-fetch stall; exact 51% hides all of it
caveats: same model weights, same coding-task distribution (one prompt family) — generalization to unseen task types not yet measured
cosine-NN is a lazy probe; a trained MLP must match it at lower inference cost (next step)
within-host random split is optimistic (adjacent-token correlation); cross-host split is the honest number
